title: Paperwork
notes: The archive: Phlox's omicron note, 2153. Paperwork, not a miracle -- the
right job for a hologram who reads everything.

lines.text: INCOMING: U.S.S. ADIRONDACK, SICKBAY
Shuttle. The Doctor. I have been reading. Don't sigh.
INCOMING: U.S.S. ADIRONDACK, SICKBAY
I have a finding and nobody to tell it to. Please.
Medical logs. The old ones. Two hundred and eighty
years of them, filed and unread, which is a crime.
In 2153 a Denobulan named Phlox stopped nanoprobes.
Borg nanoprobes, in a crewman, with omicron radiation.
He wrote it down. I appear to be the first to read it.

options.text: What does that mean for us?

lines.text: A colleague. Before my time, and everybody's.
He wrote beautifully. Almost as well as I do.
It fills in the half I couldn't read. Something Borg is
holding those bodies together and keeping them moving.
And omicron radiation takes nanoprobes apart.
They're already dead. You'd be switching them off.
Whether that's different from killing, I haven't decided.
No. I want to be very clear, because it's tempting.
It's a note in a file. It needs a laboratory, months,
and a ship that can go somewhere. We have none of it.
But it tells us what this is made of. I'd call that progress.
I have. She cried, which I am choosing to take well.
Sickbay out.
